summary: Iteration 100 (retailer self-registration + admin KYC panel) tested end-to-end on the public preview URL. Backend: existing suite test_iter100_retailer_kyc.py re-run = 12/12 PASS; added a new negative-path suite for POST /api/retailer-auth/register (9 tests, all PASS) covering GSTIN hard-block (400 'Invalid GSTIN...'), non-PDF/image mime rejection (400), empty file, malformed/short GSTIN (400/422), missing cert (422), short password (422), bad email (422) and no-DB-leak verification. Combined 21/21 pass. Verified Emergent object-storage put/get round-trip and admin certificate streaming (200, application/pdf, byte-exact). Frontend: /retailer/register (all 15 data-testids present, dark text rgb(26,25,24) on white everywhere, live GSTIN check shows red '✗ Could not verify this GSTIN', text/plain rejected client-side with toast, PDF shows register-cert-selected + remove, submit blocked with clear toast), /retailer/pending (Under Processing + revoked variants, check-status → GET /retailer-auth/me, sign-out → POST /retailer-auth/logout, unauth redirect to login, verified → auto-redirect to dashboard), layout status gate (/retailer/dashboard → /retailer/pending), retailer login returns status (under_processing/revoked 200, suspended 403 with reason), and the full /admin/retailer-requests panel (list, counts, 5 filter pills, refresh, approve, suspend w/ reason + inline 'Suspended: <reason>', unsuspend, note + expand notes list w/ audit trail, revoke w/ reason + inline text, view cert new tab, delete → row removed). All test data cleaned up (seeded retailer deleted via the panel; 0 self_registered docs remain).

minor.issue: When the stored object is missing, backend raises HTTP 502 which the Kubernetes/CDN edge replaces with an HTML Cloudflare error page — admin sees a raw gateway-error page in the new tab instead of a JSON/graceful message. Use 404 (or 424) instead of 502.

Alerts read legal_documents.gst_certificate and is_verified, but self-registration stores the cert at top-level `gst_certificate` and admin approve sets status='verified' without is_verified. An approved self-registered retailer therefore sees misleading 'GST Certificate not uploaded' + 'Account pending verification' on the dashboard.
Response `retailer` object omits business_name, so the pending screen shows the contact name under 'Business' until /me refreshes (cosmetic inconsistency).

ui_bugs.issue: Inline 'Suspended: <reason>' / 'Revoked: <reason>' render whenever the field exists, without checking status. Backend $unsets these on transition so normal flows are fine, but any stale field (e.g. data patched externally) shows 'Suspended: ...' on an under_processing row (reproduced).
Empty state text renders as 'No retailer requests .' (stray space before period).
Small files display as '0.0 KB'; consider rounding up or showing bytes.

integration_issues.issue: Spec expected the form to POST to /api/retailer-auth/register and surface the backend 400. Actual: the client hard-blocks before the POST and toasts 'GSTIN could not be verified with GSTN records. Please double-check.' (no network call). Functionally equivalent/faster UX but differs from the stated acceptance criterion — confirm this is intended.

The GSTIN gate returns before the password-mismatch check, so 'Passwords do not match' is unreachable while the GSTIN is unverified (a mismatch attempt with an invalid GSTIN toasts the GSTIN error instead). Only reachable on a verified GSTIN, which we could not test without burning Appyflow credits.
Verified self-registered retailer lands on /retailer/dashboard but sees an 'Action Required' banner claiming GST certificate not uploaded and account pending verification (see backend minor issue).

issues: No issues — all inputs render rgb(26,25,24) on white, GST panel turns red/emerald correctly, spacing and CTA contrast are good.
Footer reads '© 2026 Centsibl Traders. Admin Portal.' while the rest of the app brands as Addrika — brand inconsistency (pre-existing).
Top-right header button is near-invisible (very low contrast against the light header) — pre-existing.
Sidebar shows an empty store name because retailer.store_name is undefined for self-registered retailers.

action_items: Set is_verified=True (and/or mirror the cert into legal_documents.gst_certificate) on admin approve, or update /api/retailer-dashboard/alerts so approved self-registered retailers don't see 'GST Certificate not uploaded' / 'Account pending verification'.
Change the certificate endpoint's storage-failure status from 502 to 404/424 so the edge doesn't swap in an HTML gateway error page.
Gate the inline 'Suspended:/Revoked:' reason lines on r.status in the admin panel.
Include business_name in the POST /api/retailer-auth/login retailer payload.
Confirm intent: register form blocks submit client-side for unverified GSTINs instead of POSTing and surfacing the backend 400.
critical_code_review_comments: retailer_auth.register reads the whole upload into memory before the size check (await read() then len>8MB) — a malicious 1GB upload is buffered fully; consider streaming/Content-Length pre-check.
register() trusts the client-provided content_type for mime validation (ALLOWED_CERT_MIME) — a text file renamed and sent with content_type=application/pdf is accepted; add magic-byte sniffing.
admin_retailer_requests.DELETE hard-deletes the retailer doc but the audit trail/admin_notes are lost with it; consider archiving to a deleted_retailers collection for compliance.

AuthContext.checkAuth authenticates via cookie only while authFetch sends a Bearer header — the two paths can disagree (this is why an admin session token in localStorage alone does not unlock /admin/*).

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 pytest, plus storage round-trip and auth/error curl checks)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows functional; 3 cosmetic/consistency issues + 1 spec deviation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run `pytest tests/test_iter100_retailer_kyc.py tests/test_iter100_register_negative.py` (21 tests). Use tests/seed_iter100_ui.py to recreate a retailer + mint an admin session, and tests/set_iter100_status.py <status> [reason] to flip status and re-check the login response. tests/check_iter100_storage.py <admin_token> validates object-storage put/get + admin cert streaming. Happy-path register with a real GSTIN was deliberately NOT tested (Appyflow credits/admin inbox). After the dashboard-alerts fix, verify a freshly approved self-registered retailer sees no 'Action Required' alerts.
rca_of_the_issue: Dashboard false alerts: /api/retailer-dashboard/alerts (routers/retailers.py:1050-1063) still evaluates the legacy KYC shape (legal_documents.gst_certificate, is_verified) whereas iteration-100 self-registration persists the certificate at top-level `gst_certificate` and admin approval only writes status='verified'/verified_at. Certificate 502: HTTPException(502) from download_certificate is intercepted by the ingress/CDN, which returns its own HTML error page, so the intended JSON detail never reaches the admin.
